name: smwsprites-baby-reznor-rotating-block
title: Baby Reznor + Rotating Block
description:
This includes:
1) a baby Reznor that shoots fireballs;
2) a rotating block that moves like the gray chained platforms, but otherwise behaves like a single-block Hammer Brother platform.
The two sprites can be used as standalone, but they also function in conjuction.


Regarding the baby Reznor, depending on the extra bit, it will either walk around occasionally facing the player, or attach to the included rotating block sprite. They take 3 fireballs to kill by default.

When attached to a rotating block, hitting it with a fireball will make it drop and start walking. When its block is hit from below, it can either drop and start walking, drop and start walking with 1 health point diminished or be killed. The last option is default, but this behavior can be changed in rotating_block.asm.


Regarding the rotating block, the extra bit determines its rotation direction, and with the extra bytes you can set its speed, radius and initial angle (rotating_block.asm describes some angle values you can use to place evenly spaced concentric platforms like those seen in the screenshots). Additionally, you can enable a functionality so the level exit activates once no baby Reznors are present in the level, effectively making these sprites work as a boss.


IMPORTANT! For both sprites to work in conjuction, they must be inserted in sequence in the sprite list like so (08 and 09 are just an example - they can be on any sequential pair of numbers):

08 baby_reznor.json
09 rotating_block.json

name: smwsprites-baron-von-zeppelin
title: Baron Von Zeppelin
description:
The little balloon from SMW2:YI which holds a configurable sprite. Green Needlenose is also included.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 2, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

DrAnas update: fixed two major oversights reported by MegaSonic1999 where the extra bit option for the Baron von Zeppelin to respawn after dropping its payload didn't actually work and running away from the Baron von Zeppelin after approaching it would permanently despawn it. Also, all previously-hardcoded sprite-related defines are now extra byte options!

- Extra byte 1 = How close Mario should get in order to drop payload.
- Extra byte 2 = carried sprite is custom or normal? - 0 = normal. 1 = custom.
- Extra byte 3 = carried sprite number.
- Extra byte 4 = 16x16 tile to use for the carried sprite.
- Extra byte 5 = tile properties for carried sprite, YXPPCCCT format.

name: smwsprites-better-creating-eating-block-snakes
title: Better Creating/Eating Block Snakes
description:
This submission includes two sprites:
  • The improved Creating/Eating Block Snakes themselves
  • A custom "shooter", that spawns pairs of the main sprite

Both sprites are highly customizable and the paths are entirely determined by blocks you put in the level using Lunar Magic.
For this reason, this sprite includes a .map16 file with one row of blocks the sprite can interact with, namely:
  • turning left/right
  • turning either direction depending on the ON/OFF switch
  • changing speeds
  • terminating the snake

There's also a .dsc file that displays a description for the blocks in Lunar Magic, so you don't have to constantly reference the sprite's asm file to see what block does what.

Info on how to properly insert the blocks and the .dsc, along with lots of customization options, are in bettersnakes.asm.

name: smwsprites-bob-omb
title: Bob-omb
description: A disassembly of sprite 0D, the Bob-omb. Unlike the old one, this recreates the entirety of states of the vanilla Bob-omb, making it more accurate, not depend on bypassing the sprite status with the second extra property byte, and allowing you to customize stuff related to its carriable form.

name: smwsprites-bob-omb-leaves-fire-trail
title: Bob-omb, Leaves Fire Trail
description:
A Bob-omb which leaves a fire trail every certain amount of time, controlled by the fourth extra byte.

Requested by Green during C3 Winter 2025. That one used the old, now-removed Bob-omb disassembly. This one uses my own disassembly as a base, now with X speed, time before being quiet, and time before exploding all parametrized in extra bytes.

name: smwsprites-bouncy-boo
title: Bouncy Boo
description:
This Boo bounces around, like a Puntin' Chuck football or a Diggin' Chuck rock. You can make it bounce always, or only when not stared at.

Dedicated to Boosius, I wouldn't be able to come up with something like this myself lol.

name: smwsprites-carriable-goal-point-question-sphere
title: Carriable Goal Point Question Sphere
description:
A goal sphere which can be carried. To trigger the goal sequence, approach it without pressing X or Y.

With the extra byte, the exit triggered (normal or secret 1, 2 or 3) can be selected, and the glitter can be toggled.

name: smwsprites-carriable-reusable-p-switch-stump
title: Carriable Reusable P-Switch Stump
description:
A P-Switch stump which can be re-activated with a block.
Two blocks are included:
1. A basic block which just re-activates every stump it touches.
2. A more powerful block which can be triggered by the player, other sprites, cape and fire, and which can trigger only one or all stumps of either one color or both colors. It can also change into another Map16 tile and it includes an optional bounce sprite.

Requested by 3dsalmon.

name: smwsprites-chasing-explosive-swooper
title: Chasing (Explosive) Swooper
description:
A swooper that chases after player after being disturbed. Includes an explosive variant that explodes after a little while.

Requested by Roberto zampari and SF - The Dark Warrior during Winter C3 2023.

name: smwsprites-chasing-hidden-rex
title: Chasing & Hidden Rex
description:
This is a Rex that chases you, like Disco Shell. In fact, it can be set to flash and become invulnerable to stomps.
It can also be set to remain "hidden" untill player comes close.

Requested by Roberto zampari, zacmario and Ganbare-Lucifer.

name: smwsprites-conditional-keyhole
title: Conditional Keyhole
description:
A keyhole that will only appear if a specified flag is set or clear, depending on the extra bit. If the extra bit is set, it will only appear when the flag is set (non-zero) and vice-versa. The extra bytes determine which flag to use: common flags are P-switch and ON/OFF. You can find other addresses at the RAM map.

You can optionally fix the keyholes only detecting the key in the highest sprite slot with the !detect_any_key define. The fix is enabled by default.

name: smwsprites-custom-smw-like-iggy-boss
title: Custom SMW-Like Iggy Boss
description:
Video: LINK

This is a custom Iggy Boss I coded for Mario's Enigmatic Tales. A rather simple boss that can be used in earlier worlds.

Special thanks to Sonikku for the graphics (ripped from MFGG). Credit is always a plus for the code.

name: smwsprites-customizable-lemmy-wendy
title: Customizable Lemmy/Wendy
description:
A customizable Lemmy/Wendy boss based on the disassembly by yoshicookiezeus. Features include:

- Set the number of hits to kill the boss
- Very flexible method of giving spawn positions and patterns for the boss and their dummies (can be used in levels larger than one screen)
- Support for autoscroll fights, including manual tweaking of cycle timings
- Upside down spawns
- Flexible interaction behavior between the boss/dummies and Mario/carriable sprites/fireballs
- Support for custom graphics
- And more (see the readme and config file for a full list)

name: smwsprites-dino-rhino-dino-torch
title: Dino Rhino + Dino Torch
description:
A disassembly of sprites 6E and 6F, the Dino Rhino and the Dino Torch.

Only difference from the original code is to check for the extra bit instead of the sprite number, as in reality, the Dinos share pretty much all of their code and are only differentiated by number in some situations.

name: smwsprites-electricity
title: Electricity
description: "Electricity" sprite by mikeyk converted to PIXI, i've also included the spark GFX from SMB2.

name: smwsprites-expanded-dino-rhino-dino-torch
title: Expanded Dino Rhino + Dino Torch
description:
This is an expansion of the Dino Rhino and the Dino Torch, sprites 6E and 6F of Super Mario World. An extra bit of 2 will make this a Dino Rhino, and an extra bit of 3 will make this a Dino Torch.

This variant includes some code optimizations from the original, as well as changes, such as:
* The Dino Rhino can now spit two kinds of flame, or spit nothing.
* The Dino Torch can be made to spit nothing.
* The Dino Rhino can turn into a Dino Torch or die instantly.
* The pattern can be random or fixed.

name: smwsprites-explosive-dry-bones
title: Explosive Dry Bones
description:
Explosive Dry Bones:

Description: This are a variant version of the Dry Bones, that acts like the SMW ones, but when the player stomp him and he are showing the crumble animation, he will start flashing and explode.

Features:
PIXI Support/Compatibility.
SA-1 Support/Compatibility.
JSON Support.
A documentation (Readme) file.
Allow customize the sprite easily with a bunch of defines!

More details are in the included "Readme" file.

Requested by Anorakun

name: smwsprites-falling-fireball-generator
title: Falling Fireball Generator
description:
Generates falling fireballs from the top of the screen. The fireballs fall and disappear in a puff of smoke when they encounter the ground. If a fireball encounters certain blocks, it makes them shatter.

There are many configuration options in the sprite and generator files, such as which sizes to spawn the fireballs in (16x16, 16x32 or both), the spawning rate per horizontal screen, which map16 tiles should be shattered by the fireballs (by default, they shatter item blocks and derivatives) and more.

Make sure to set the fireball's sprite number in the generator's .asm file!

name: smwsprites-flame-trail-galoomba
title: Flame Trail Galoomba
description:
A Galoomba that leaves a flame trail as it's walking on the ground.

Requested by JP32 during Winter C3 2024. Credit is unecessary.

name: smwsprites-fling-blocks
title: Fling Blocks
description:
Fling Blocks will activate, and fling Mario or sprites upwards upon contact.

When flinging Mario, the Fling Blocks will not stop spinning until he touches the ground. When flinging sprites, the Fling Blocks will spin for 15 frames. None can interact with Fling Blocks are they are spinning.

Also included is a Red Fling Block variation, as the extra bit option. Red Fling Blocks only get activated by sprites, and Mario can use it as a sprite platform.

Now PIXI compatible.

name: smwsprites-floor-button
title: Floor Button
description:
A custom floor button switch sprite I made (flatter than a P-switch) that includes several features:
  • Flip on/off switch (including toggling and 1-way)
  • Flip blue/silver P-switch (including toggling and 1-way)
  • Flip Custom triggers (exanimation, toggle and 1-way)
  • Flip switch palace flags (toggle and 1-way)
  • Mario vs Donkey Kong colored switches (exanimation's manuel triggers)
  • Emit signal that does something based on what block the signal travels into


Basically, this is the custom sprite version of my 16x8 block switch I made long ago.

name: smwsprites-flying-grinder
title: Flying Grinder
description:
This evil variant of a Grinder has wings! It has two patterns, one where it flies in a determined range or, and a second one where it chases the player around. This, as well as the speed, can be configured as extra bytes.

Requested by GatheringStorm.

name: smwsprites-flying-key
title: Flying Key
description:
It's a flying key that resembles SMW's key unfinished flying variant, that can be achieved with glitches. It flies in same pattern as unused red coin or golden 1-up sprites, and it can be picked up from above.

Credit is optional.

name: smwsprites-galoomba-climbs-walls
title: Galoomba, Climbs Walls
description:
A version of Galoomba that climbs walls similar to Dino Rhinos/Dino Torches.

Requested by JP32 during Winter C3 2023.

name: smwsprites-galoomba-smw-goomba

description: This is a disassembly of sprite 0F in SMW, Galoomba (SMW Goomba).

name: smwsprites-galoomba-sticks-to-walls
title: Galoomba, Sticks to Walls
description:
A variant of Galoomba that sticks to walls when thrown. After a little bit, it unstuns itself, so it can be jumped on again. After a little while, it'll unstick from the wall.

Requested by RollingRigatonis during Winter C3 2023.

name: smwsprites-goal-roulette
title: Goal Roulette
description:
This is a custom made Goal Roulette, inspired by the one from SMWCP II. The player can hit it to get either a yellow coin (5 coins), blue coin (10 coins), red coin (20 coins), Mushroom, 1-Up, Fire Flower, or nothing at all. The extra byte determines whether it triggers the normal exit or a secret exit.

Check the ASM file for customization options.

Credit isn't required but would be nice.

name: smwsprites-homing-torpedo-ted
title: Homing Torpedo Ted
description:
A Torpedo Ted that will stop, point at the player's direction, charge forward and repeat. If the extra bit is set, it will explode after some time.

A launcher is included. Setting the extra bit to the launcher will transfer the explosive behavior to the launched sprite.

Make sure to check the .asm files for various configurations.


Your first dynamic sprite? A few notes for you:
  • If not using SA-1, the Dynamic Sprites Patch is required.
  • The Torpedo Ted's graphics are uploaded dynamically, so ExGFX is not required. The enclosed file is only to match the launcher hand with the explosion star, both not dynamic.
  • Nevertheless, dynamic sprites take up the lower half of SP4, so you should not use sprites that take graphics from that region unless you remap them.

name: smwsprites-iggy-boss
title: Iggy Boss 2024 Edition
description:
This is an Iggy Boss which can be defeated with 5 hits which will deffert
when Iggy is hit, he will be an a Shell
on the third and fourth hit Iggy will Spit out a Fireball from the Bowser Statue Sprite
on Extra Bit 3 Iggy will throw hammers on the third and fourth hit
Requested by SMW Magic

2026/03/23

name: smwsprites-line-guided-colored-blocks-switch-toggled
title: Line Guided Colored Blocks, Switch Toggled
description:
A line guided 3-block platform that can have various colors. The platform can be in an inactive state, in which it doesn't move, and in an active state, in which, naturally, it moves.

With the extra bit set, this sprite becomes a switch which will toggle every existing platform's state. The switch can also have multiple colors and will only act upon platforms that match its color.

Inspired by a similar entity in Super Mario Bros. X.

versions.title: Line Guided Colored Blocks, Switch Toggled

name: smwsprites-mother-dino-rhino-dino-torch-egg
title: Mother Dino Rhino + Dino Torch Egg
description:
A Dino Rhino that occasionally lays eggs with Dino Torches inside. The eggs will hatch immediately.

If the extra bit is set, this sprite is instead an independent Dino Torch egg. It will hatch when the player is in close proximity, like baby Yoshi eggs.

The .asm file features many customisation options, including changing which sprite hatches out of the egg and even which sprite the Dino Rhino becomes when stomped.

versions.title: Mother Dino Rhino + Dino Torch Egg

name: smwsprites-moving-midway-point-tape
title: Moving Midway Point Tape
description:
It's like a goal tape, but a midway point tape instead. It automatically detects the height of the pole as long as the "Act as" settings of the left pole are correct (2F-31) so you can place it comfortably. Extra Byte 1 determines its speed.

When collected, the tape will give some points. The higher the tape is hit, the higher the score. If the tape is hit at the highest possible spot, which is frame perfect, a 1-up will be given. These features can optionally be disabled.

Not compatible with any multiple midway point patches yet, sorry!

name: smwsprites-mr-saturn
title: Mr. Saturn
description:
Mr. Saturn walks peacefully. If grabbed, he can be thrown at enemies, destroying them relentlessly.

title: New Super Mario Bros. - Stretch Shroom
description: A mushroom platform which expands and contracts over a certain period of time. When on top, the player moves along with it.

name: smwsprites-optimized-banzai-bill
title: Optimized Banzai Bill
description: This is an edited disassembly of sprite 9F in SMW, the Banzai Bill. I also made it able to go either direction if the extra bit is set (the original one doesn't show up at all when the player comes from the other direction).  This sprite draws 16 tiles, so it requires the No Sprite Tile Limits patch; even sprite memory setting 04, which was used with the original Banzai Bill, doesn't seem to work.

name: smwsprites-para-spiny-flies-in-an-ellipse-pattern
title: Para-spiny, Flies in an Ellipse Pattern
description:
A winged Spiny which flies in an elliptic range (can also be circular), controlled by the extra bytes.

Dedicated to Koopster who made the graphics routine (and the original Para-spiny).

versions.title: Para-spiny, Flies in an Ellipse Pattern

name: smwsprites-parachute-thwomp
title: Parachute Thwomp
description:
Exactly what it says on the tin. It's a Thwomp with a tiny parachute.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by Sammmoo

name: smwsprites-pokey-heading-yoshi-s-island-pokey
title: Pokey Heading (Yoshi's Island Pokey)
description:
This is an enemy from Yoshi's Island that was always really funny.
The Needlenose that it spawns can be defeated by thrown objects or eaten by Yoshi, which will make the Pokey really sad.
The Pokey itself is mostly-invulnerable, only able to die from a star powered player, explosions, and lava.

There are 5 varieties available by default, accessible via Extra Byte 1;
- Green: Original behavior.
- Yellow: Launches the Needlenose at a consistent height.
- Red: Launches the Needlenose at much lower heights.
- Blue: Same behavior as the green variant, but its Needlenose never regrows, so it stays sad forever.
- Gray: The last bounce of its pattern will make the Needlenose explode.
More varieties with different patterns can be added from the ASM file.

Extra Byte 2 will delay its initial bounce of the Needlenose, allowing you to fine-tune it.

This sprite has also been uploaded on my Patreon, available here.

name: smwsprites-pot
title: Pot
description:
This is a 16x16 pot sprite. Mario can stand on it, push it, and pick it up to move it. When he drops it, it will break and spawn another sprite. It must spawn on a solid tile.

It uses its extra bytes to determine which sprite it should spawn (they can be set in the Add Sprite Manual dialog with the "Extension" field). The first byte (first two digits) determines the sprite number to spawn (get it either from the Add Sprites Window or from PIXI's list.txt). The next digit determines which status the sprite should spawn in (if unsure, use 1). The fourth digit is the extra bit of the sprite to spawn. 0 and 1 spawn a normal sprite with its extra bit clear or set, 2 and 3 spawn a custom sprite with its extra bit clear or set (just like the Extra Bits field from the Add Sprite Manual dialog). For example, extension 8010 would spawn vanilla sprite 80 (a key) in status 1 with its extra bit clear. 0583 would spawn custom sprite 05 in status 8 with its extra bit set. If you set the sprite number to FF, the pot will shatter without spawning anything.

If the extra bit of the pot is set, then it'll randomly leave nothing behind, or spawn one of two sprites. The second sprite is defined in the extension after the first one (in the same format). For example, a pot with its extra bit set and extension 80110582 would either spawn nothing, a key in status 1 with its extra bit set, or custom sprite 05 in status 8 with its extra bit clear.

Check the ASM file for customization options. The included graphics use Mario's palette and come from BlackSabbath's SMB2 tileset.

name: smwsprites-random-chance-sprite-spawner
title: Random Chance Sprite Spawner
description:
This helper sprite will replace itself with another sprite with a given probability. If it fails, nothing will spawn.

Respawn when going offscreen and returned is handled in two ways, via the 
!keep_track
define.
  • If 
    !keep_track = 0
    , the spawn succeeds, and you go off-screen and return, the sprite's probability to spawn is re-rolled.
  • If 
    !keep_track = 1
    , the spawn succeeds, and you go off-screen and return, the sprite will ALWAYS spawn again. This feature requires 32 bytes of free RAM and, if you're not clearing RAM elsewhere, UberASM.


Can spawn a vanilla or custom sprite, with the extra bit clear or set, with any given X/Y offset, and with up to four extra bytes.

name: smwsprites-random-different-sprite-spawner
title: Random Different Sprite Spawner
description:
This helper sprite will spawn one of two different sprites, depending on a probability.

Respawn when going offscreen and returned is handled in three ways, via the 
!respawn_type
define.
  • If 
    !respawn_type= 0
    , when you go off-screen and return, nothing will spawn anymore.
  • If 
    !respawn_type= 1
    , when you go off-screen and return, the same sprite will spawn again. This feature requires 64 bytes of free RAM and, if you're not clearing RAM elsewhere, UberASM.
  • If 
    !respawn_type= 2
    , when you go off-screen and return, the probability will be re-rolled and the other sprite might spawn.


Can spawn vanilla and/or custom sprites, with the extra bit clear or set, and with up to four different extra bytes for either. Be sure to read the asm file thoroughly, this uses 12 extra bytes!

name: smwsprites-rip-van-fish
title: Rip Van Fish
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 3D, the Rip Van Fish. Unlike the older disassembly, it fixes some oddities with slopes, removes a lot of irrelevant code, and has more defines to edit it in a more user friendly way.

Dedicated to Segment1Zone2 who brought the issues with the older disassembly to my attention.

name: smwsprites-statue-chuck-v1
title: Statue Chuck v1.1
description:
This is a Chuck statue, which the player can stand on. After getting close enough to it (determined by the extra byte 1), it begins shaking, and some seconds later (determined by the extra byte 2) it shatters into a Chargin' Chuck It can have gravity or not, depending on the extra bit.

Use this tweak to have gray shatter particles.

Requested by RobloxNewbie19001.

name: smwsprites-sumo-brother-ex
title: Sumo Brother EX
description:
A version of the Sumo Brother that spawns a highly configurable fire wall. With the extra bytes, you can control how far the fire spreads, how fast it spreads and how long the flames take to dissipate. Additionally, fire will only spread if ground is detected, no longer spawning on thin air like the original.

In the sprite's .asm file, you can also configure how long the Sumo Brother's cycle lasts and his speed when stepping to the side. You could make him extremely quick.

Included is a custom flame cluster sprite. Make sure to insert it and set up the define !cluster_flame_id accordingly in the sprite's .asm file! The cluster sprite is required to allow for up to 20 flames to be on screen at once, unlike the original flames of which there can only be 10. It also fixes the sprite teleportation bug and the extended hitbox below.

name: smwsprites-super-bob-omb
title: Super Bob-omb
description:
This is a Super Bob-omb, inspired and rehauled from its original japanese code. It behaves like a normal Bob-omb, but it has a wider explosion range.

Includes .cfg and .json files. Tested with SA-1 and the latest version of PIXI.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-bros
title: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Spike and Spike Ball
description:
SMB3 style Spike and spike ball

Green - SMB3 Spike
Blue - Stone Spike (throws spike balls towards the screen)
Red - Fire Spike (throws fireballs instead of a spike ball)
Extra bit - move/stay flag

Requested by CalHal

versions.title: Super Mario Bros. 3 - Spike and Spike Ball
Super Mario Bros. 3 - Buzzy Beetle / Spiny

name: smwsprites-super-mario-bros-wonder-serpont
title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Serpont
description:
A snake enemy from Super Mario Bros. Wonder that hides in a pot.

It will emerge from the pot when the player approaches it. This pot gives the Serpont immunity to fireballs, but shatters when the player jumps on it, causing it to move faster. Stomping on it again will squish it. Alternatively, spin jumping on it (or stomping on it with Yoshi) will immediately kill it.

If the extra bit is set, it will spawn already moving. Its extended/extra bytes determine its pot tile and its properties, alongside its X speed before and after breaking its pot, allowing for custom "angry" variants and the like.

Additionally, this sprite should be initialized properly when spawned by a generator or another sprite like a Lakitu. See the top of the .asm file for more information.

name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-swimming-goomba
title: Super Mario Maker - Swimming Goomba
description:
This is a goomba.
It moves underwater in Mario Maker.
It will chase player when player enter a certain range.

name: smwsprites-toothy-s-pipe
title: Toothy's Pipe
description:
A carriable pipe. While carried, Toothy, a piranha plant, comes out of it and kills enemies. You can optionally enable it to shatter specified map16 tiles on contact.

Originally from Super Mario Bros. X.
